localTaxNote: PARAPHRASE: REV-415 directs Act 32 / local EIT questions to DCED (Quick Reference Guide for Payroll Providers, 'Act 32', printed page 22); rates other than Philadelphia are not verified. Optional user input default is 0%. Philadelphia wage tax rate: residents 3.735% effective July 1, 2026; nonresidents 3.425% (phila.gov rate table).

statePayrollTaxes.name: PA Unemployment Compensation (Employee)
statePayrollTaxes.source: PA Dept of Labor & Industry Employee Withholding page (2023 and thereafter)

notes: PARAPHRASE: PA REV-415 (SU) 01-23, printed page 11: PA PIT is a flat 3.07% on gross compensation, with no standard deduction or personal exemptions.
PARAPHRASE: PA REV-415 (SU) 01-23, printed page 6: 401(k) salary-reduction contributions are included in PA gross taxable wages.

UNVERIFIED: REV-415 covers employer payments for medical/dental/vision welfare plans, but does not explicitly address employee Section 125 salary-reduction premiums. Pending official primary sourcing, employee health premiums and HSA contributions are treated as taxable for PA by default.
Employee Unemployment Compensation (UC) is 0.07% on ALL gross wages without cap (PA Dept of Labor & Industry). Rounding rule: compute to 3 decimals, drop excess, round to nearest cent.
